ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and other cases of social services fraud.
questions: What is the total amount of money lost to child care fraud in Minnesota?
How many people have been charged in connection with child care fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and to hold those responsible accountable. It requires careful analysis of financial records and interviews with key sources.
